title: 第18章 龙血丹第19章 宗师
content_zh:
夜幕降临。
明轩殿內灯火通明。
宽阔的庭院里，摆放著一尊尊炼丹炉，炉火烧的通红。
十几名衣著考究，气质不凡的炼药师，正聚在一起推杯换盏。
杯光烛影，气氛融洽。
“我提议大家一起向二皇子殿下敬上一杯！”
“我同意，二殿下爱才之心人尽皆知，吾等草民今日到大乾宫中做客欢宴，都依赖二殿下的赏识。”
夏瑞明摆了摆手：“各位都是大乾皇朝闻名遐邇的炼药师，是国之栋樑，中流砥柱，能够邀请来各位，是孤的荣幸，诸位不必客气，同饮此杯，接下来便是诸位表现的时间了。”
与庭院里热闹非凡的景象不同，二楼的气氛明显就要冷淡许多。
今日受邀前来的，有长公主夏紫萱，六公主夏蓝曦，以及三皇子夏哲彦。
七位皇子皇女凑齐了四个，倒也算得上是大场面了。
尤其是在祖龙祭典已经开启的现在，皇子皇女相互为敌，能有这样相聚一堂的机会，还是很难得的。
除了这几人外，受邀而来的宾客还有几个。
大多是宫中的宦官权臣，看起来应该是夏瑞明的党羽。
楚夏对朝堂上的事情不太清楚，但其中一人，他却认得。
甚至可以说很熟。
此人一身黑色劲装，天庭饱满，神采奕奕，身形非常健硕，浑身散发著野兽一般的气息。
他名叫陆奇峰，是神武军的一名副將！
楚夏父亲的旧部之一。
一位拥有化劫境五重修为的武道强者。

看到陆奇峰的时候，楚夏心中略有些感慨。
父亲死后，神武军名存实亡，虽然大部分忠诚的將士还会选择留下，但也挡不住一些有志之士另谋出路。
陆奇峰肯定不是特例，现在神武军的高层，估计已经走了一半了。
但楚夏也能够理解。
毕竟人往高处走嘛。
现在的神武军，已经辉煌不在了。
这时，楼下传来一阵闹腾的声音。
“要开始了，我先下去看看。”
夏蓝曦跑的最快，第一时间下去。
三皇子夏哲彦微笑道：“皇姐，我们也下去瞧瞧吧，二哥这次召集这么多炼药师来，我还挺好奇他想炼製什么丹药，听说他这次为了筹集灵药，可是砸下了重金。”
夏紫萱点了点头。
“哲彦，听说你前些日子去武极宗闭关，成功突破了化劫境，恭喜你了。”
“侥倖而已。”夏哲彦淡淡一笑，神態从容。
很快，一行人便陆陆续续来到了楼下的庭院中。
这时夏瑞明麾下的龙渊卫，正运送一批灵药进来。
其中最引人注目的，是一株有半人高的血红色灵芝。
灵芝表面，还生长了密密麻麻的水泡。
虽然看起来有点辣眼睛，跟感染了毒素似的，但靠近一闻，却有一股无法言喻的奇香扑面而来，直衝天灵盖。
炼药师们看到这株灵芝，都忍不住惊嘆起来。
“居然是经过玄蛟涎淬链过的血茸灵芝，这可是极其稀少罕见的异化灵药。”

“这么大的异化血茸灵芝，简直闻所未闻，这可是用来炼製龙血丹的极品材料。”
“这品质无敌了，炼出来的龙血丹恐怕能够达到九品！”
就连夏紫萱都震惊於夏瑞明的大手笔。
这一株异化血茸灵芝的价格，绝对十分惊人。
content_en:
Night falls.
The Mingxuan Hall is brightly lit.
In the wide courtyard, there is an alchemy furnace, the fire is burning red.
A dozen or so well-dressed alchemists with extraordinary temperament are gathering together to exchange cups.
The glass is lit by candles and the atmosphere is harmonious.
"I propose that everyone raise a toast to His Highness the Second Prince!"
"I agree. His Highness's love for talents is well known to everyone. We, the ordinary people, come to Daqian Palace for a banquet today, and we all rely on His Highness's appreciation."
Xia Ruiming waved his hand: "You are all well-known alchemists in the Daqian Dynasty. You are the pillars and mainstays of the country. It is my honor to invite you here. You don't have to be polite. Let's drink this cup together. Next is the time for you to show off."
Different from the lively scene in the courtyard, the atmosphere on the second floor is obviously much cooler.
Those invited here today are the eldest princess Xia Zixuan, the sixth princess Xia Lanxi, and the third prince Xia Zheyan.
Four of the seven princes and princesses gathered together, which can be considered a big scene.
Especially now that the Ancestral Dragon Festival has begun, the prince and princess are enemies of each other, so it is still rare to have such an opportunity to get together.
In addition to these few people, there were several other invited guests.
Most of them were eunuchs and powerful ministers in the palace, and they seemed to be Xia Ruiming's party members.
Chu Xia didn't know much about what happened in the court, but he recognized one of them.
It can even be said to be familiar.
This man was dressed in black and powerful, full of heaven, full of energy, very strong, and exuding a beast-like aura.
His name is Lu Qifeng, and he is a deputy general of the Shenwu Army!
One of Chu Xia's father's old subordinates.
A martial arts expert with fifth-level cultivation in the Tribulation Realm.
When she saw Lu Qifeng, Chu Xia felt a little emotional.
After his father's death, the Shenwu Army existed in name only. Although most of the loyal soldiers would choose to stay, it could not stop some people with lofty ideals from finding another way out.
Lu Qifeng is definitely not a special case. Now the top leaders of the Shenwu Army are probably halfway gone.
But Chu Xia can also understand.
After all, people go to higher places.
The current Shenwu Army is no longer glorious.
At this time, there was a commotion downstairs.
"It's time to start, I'll go down and take a look first."
Xia Lanxi ran the fastest and got down immediately.
The third prince, Xia Zheyan, smiled and said, "Sister, let's go down and take a look. The second brother has summoned so many alchemists this time. I'm quite curious about what kind of elixir he wants to refine. I heard that he spent a lot of money to raise the elixir this time."
Xia Zixuan nodded.
"Zheyan, I heard that you went to Wuji Sect for retreat a few days ago and successfully broke through the realm of transformation. Congratulations."
"It's just a fluke." Xia Zheyan smiled lightly, with a calm expression.
Soon, a group of people came to the courtyard downstairs one after another.
At this time, Xia Ruiming's Long Yuan Guards were transporting a batch of elixirs.
The most eye-catching one is a blood-red Ganoderma lucidum half as tall as a man.
There are also dense blisters growing on the surface of Ganoderma lucidum.
Although it looks a bit irritating to the eyes, as if it is infected with toxins, when you get closer and smell it, there is an indescribable and strange fragrance that hits your face and goes straight to the Tianling Cap.
When the alchemists saw this Ganoderma lucidum, they couldn't help but marvel.
"It's actually the Blood Velvet Ganoderma that has been quenched by the Xuan Jiao's saliva. This is an extremely rare and rare alienated elixir."
"Such a large alienated blood velvet Ganoderma is simply unheard of. This is the best material used to refine dragon blood pills."
"This quality is incomparable. The refined dragon blood elixir can probably reach the ninth level!"
Even Xia Zixuan was shocked by Xia Ruiming's generosity.
The price of this alienated blood antler Ganoderma is absolutely astonishing.
